solution_summary: It’s no secret that reducing greenhouse emissions is essential to mitigating climate change. Yet while many companies work hard to achieve net-zero emissions, measuring and reducing carbon emissions can remain challenging, especially for large enterprises that rely on their suppliers for emissions data. From an architecture standpoint, Terrascope is powered by a cloud-based carbon accounting system built using AWS Fargate , a serverless, pay-as-you-go compute engine. To automate its data pipelines and keep its operations running seamlessly, Terrascope uses Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA), a secure and highly available managed workflow orchestration service. To provide customers with rapid, secure access to the site tailored to their region, Terrascope relies on Amazon CloudFront , a content delivery network (CDN) service built for high performance, security, and developer convenience. To address the challenge of measuring and reducing Scope 3 emissions, Terrascope built a decarbonization SaaS platform.

Powered by AWS, with machine learning at the core, the solution provides enterprises with the data, analytics, and reduction planning tools that they need to decarbonize their business operations and supply chains.

Terrascope increases confidence in emissions data and insights through AI-powered emissions factor (EF) matching, hotspot analytics, decarbonisation recommendations, and supplier engagement capabilities.

It offers a structured platform for data collection, processing, accurate emission calculation, and analytics, streamlining the emission accounting cycle through automation and machine learning, allowing internal teams to focus on post-measurement reduction efforts.
With this solution, enterprises can take actionable steps to reduce their Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 emissions.
